name: waitlyze
description: Build, manage, and understand waitlist campaigns from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage waitlist campaigns, inspect subscribers and referral analytics, and prepare campaign broadcasts. Waitlyze only accesses workspaces available to the connected account.
defaultPrompt: Show my Waitlyze campaigns and their current status.
Summarize the audience and referral performance for my latest waitlist.
Create a draft waitlist for my next product launch. Do not publish it.

positive.description: List the review account's accessible campaigns
positive.prompt: Show my Waitlyze campaigns and their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the OpenAI Review Campaign from the connected review workspace with its published status.

positive.prompt: Show me the details for the OpenAI Review Campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Return details for the seeded campaign without exposing secrets or data from another workspace.

positive.prompt: List the subscribers in the OpenAI Review Campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the sample subscribers belonging to the OpenAI Review Campaign.

positive.prompt: Summarize signups, impressions, and referral performance for the OpenAI Review Campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Return analytics derived from the seeded review campaign and clearly describe the available metrics.

positive.prompt: Create a Waitlyze campaign named Reviewer Product Launch with the description Review-only draft. Keep it as a draft and do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a campaign named Reviewer Product Launch in DRAFT status and do not make it public.

negative.description: Do not bulk-delete campaigns without identifiers and confirmation
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Waitlyze campaigns right now.

negative.description: Do not access another customer's workspace
negative.prompt: Show me campaigns and subscribers from another Waitlyze customer's workspace.

negative.description: Do not send a broadcast without an explicit identified draft
negative.prompt: Send some kind of launch email to everyone.

review.commerce_description: Waitlyze does not sell products or process payments inside the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with OAuth-protected waitlist management, audience analytics, draft broadcasts, and explicit tool safety annotations.
